context: M10 o4. Seoul Star Imports, W 29th. Mr. Baek at the counter, pocket calculator out. Mrs. Baek in back.

lines.speaker: char.jung_ho_baek
lines.text: Again you. Last month a truck. This month a gentleman. Next month, what? A dog?

lines.speaker: char.mi_sook_baek
lines.text: My husband talks. I count. Today we counted wrong.

lines.speaker: char.jung_ho_baek
lines.text: Twenty dollars. I give you twenty dollars. I want a receipt.

lines.speaker: char.jung_ho_baek
lines.text: Then I make one. 'Twenty dollars, for nothing.' Sign here, please.

lines.speaker: char.mi_sook_baek
lines.text: Protection from what? The only thing I fear is the landlord.
